test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Match the following:

 
 

 **Natural** **source**
 **Acid**
 
 

 **i.**
 Lemon
 **a.**
 Methanoic acid
 
 

 **ii.**
 Nettle sting
 **b.**
 Citric acid
 
 

 **iii.**
 Tomato
 **c.**
 Oxalic acid

options.text: i - a, ii - b, iii - c
i - c, ii - a, iii - b
i - c, ii - b, iii - a
i - b, ii - a, iii - c

solution:
The correct answer is __**i-b, ii-a,iii-c**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lemon**:

 
 
• Contains **citric acid**.
 
 
 
• **Nettle sting**:
 
 
• Contains **methanoic acid** (also known as formic acid), which is responsible for the stinging sensation.
 
 
 
• **Tomato**:
 
 
• Contains **oxalic acid** in smaller amounts.
 
 
 
• So the correct matching is

 
 

 Natural source
 Acid
 
 

 i.
 Lemon
 **b.**
 Citric acid
 
 

 ii.
 Nettle sting
 a.
 Methanoic acid
 
 

 iii.
 Tomato
 c.
 Oxalic acid
 
 

 
• 
 
Thus, the correct matches are: **i - b, ii - a, iii - c**
